What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_MD-*.pod, doc/man3/EVP_DigestInit.pod and providers/implementations/digests/ state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::shake_128` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::shake_256` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::sha3_224`, `digests::sha3_256`, `digests::sha3_384` and `digests::sha3_512`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
